game_title: Flowchart Lab · Count up to n
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the cooling vent.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Print the whole numbers from 1 through n. If n is zero, print nothing. Problem values 10, 5; test inputs [{'n': 0}, {'n': 1}, {'n': 20}, {'n': 10}, {'n': 5}, {'n': 15}].
controls: Drag flowchart symbols onto numbered positions and follow the arrows. Check chart executes every case. Arrow keys and Enter also place selected blocks.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cinder Cone Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 390 points of ore chunks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Boolean Circuit – Cinder Cone Camp Rush
hint: Trace the arrows. Read input before using it; use rectangles for assignments and diamonds for decisions.
